process_mention_data: process mention samples into tokenized context and candidate tensors for a biencoder model
get_context_representation: tokenize a mention with left and right context into padded input IDs for the biencoder
get_candidate_representation: tokenize a candidate entity description with optional title into padded input IDs for the biencoder
select_field: extract a list of values from a nested list of dictionaries by key
review_process_mention_data: review the process_mention_data function to understand how samples are tokenized and converted to PyTorch tensors
